LSESU Economics Society Essay Competition 2026

1 September 2026

Eligible senior secondary students worldwide and students entering university in 2026/27 may participate.

Eligible senior secondary students worldwide can enter the LSESU Economics Society's 2026 essay competition by submitting an English essay of up to 1,500 words on one of five economics questions

Conrad Challenge 2026–2027

30 October 2026

Students aged 13–18 worldwide may participate in teams of 2–5 with a coach aged 18 or older.

Students aged 13–18 can form teams of 2–5 and develop STEM-based innovations addressing real-world problems in the international Conrad Challenge

Immerse Education Essay Competition 2027

25 October 2026

Students worldwide who will be aged 13–18 when the programmes covered by the scholarships begin.

In this free international essay competition for students aged 13–18, participants submit a 500-word academic essay for the chance to earn scholarships of up to 100% toward Immerse Education programmes
